mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact typed compression, scalar and matrix trajectories, memory and checkpoint identities, five recursively advanced finite-memory cutoffs, formal coefficients, and invariant-packet controls for the fixed rational two-state example.
mathematics.conventions: Column vectors; T=[[1/2,1/4],[1/4,1/2]]; R selects the first coordinate. Lag zero is a two-step leave-and-return path. Cutoff m retains m past contributions in addition to the current value. Formal series coefficients are indexed from zero.
inputs: T, R, S, P, P_plus, P_minus and checkpoint map displayed in the study
non_claims: Finite checks do not prove general-time or general-cutoff statements; their elementary proofs are supplied separately in the text.
No random noise, rounding, physical-model, universal-matrix, or new Lean claim.
